questions.passage:
Halberd Materials Plans New Bioplastics Plants

March 8 (Rotterdam)—Halberd Materials announced plans to build and operate a large bioplastics plant in southern Portugal. Chief executive Ingrid Vasco thanked the Portuguese government, saying, “The combination of investment allowances and direct grants turned this project from an idea into something we could build.” She added that the Evora site, which Halberd bought for €22 million, is ideal. Although it is remotely situated—more than 180 kilometres from the nearest city—the site is conveniently located near both a freight railway and a motorway. That will make it useful to transfer equipment and materials in and out. The M4 Bioplastics Plants is expected to produce up to 90,000 tons of material on a yearly basis and is planned to start operations early next year.

Nuno Ferreira
Halberd Materials
Rua do Alecrim 44, Lisboa

4 November

Dear Mr. Ferreira,

Enclosed with this letter is the environmental compliance report for the 120,000-ton M4 Bioplastics Plants at Evora. Overall, my department was impressed by your efforts to meet every relevant regulation. There are, however, two problems that must be handled:

1. Secondary containment must be fitted around the solvent tanks in case of a leak.

2. Further air-quality monitors must be installed across the site. The report gives the exact positions.

On 10 December, a member of my team will return to the factory to confirm that these problems have been resolved. Please contact me with any questions.

Yours sincerely,

Beatriz Salgado
Directorate of Industrial Standards, Lisbon

MEMORANDUM

To:All Halberd Department Heads
From:Nuno Ferreira, Director of Operations
Date:15 December
Subject:M4 Bioplastics Plants

The M4 Bioplastics Plants will start production on 8 March as planned. There was some concerns about a delay because of the problems raised by the Directorate of Industrial Standards, but our lead engineer, Petra Nowak, saw to them before the 10 December deadline. I am very grateful to her.

On a related point, we still have several shift supervisor positions needed to be filled at the facility. Please check the e-mail I sent last week detailing the requirements. If there is someone you would like to recommend, please contact me by 20 December. Thank you.

Đã có một số lo ngại về việc chậm tiến độ do những vấn đề mà Cục Tiêu chuẩn Công nghiệp nêu ra, nhưng kỹ sư trưởng của chúng ta, chị Petra Nowak, đã xử lý xong chúng trước hạn chót ngày 10 tháng Mười hai. Tôi rất biết ơn chị ấy.
Về một việc liên quan, chúng ta vẫn còn vài vị trí tổ trưởng ca cần được lấp đầy tại cơ sở này. Xin quý vị xem lại thư điện tử tôi gửi tuần trước nêu chi tiết các yêu cầu. Nếu có ai đó quý vị muốn tiến cử, xin liên hệ với tôi trước ngày 20 tháng Mười hai. Xin cảm ơn.

(chúng ta vẫn còn vài vị trí tổ trưởng ca cần được lấp đầy tại cơ sở này)

Paraphrase:
Bài đọc: "if there is someone you would like to recommend, please contact me by 20 December" (nếu muốn tiến cử ai, hãy liên hệ trước ngày 20 tháng Mười hai)
Đáp án: "nominate a candidate for an available position" (tiến cử một ứng viên cho một vị trí đang trống)

Date: 5 May
Customer: Solstice Gallery
Reservation #: 6317-C
Service Date: 16 May
Payment Due Date: 12 May (All Payments Final)

Service Details & Cost Breakdown

ItemDescriptionCost

To:Callum Sweeney <c.sweeney@solsticegallery.com>
From:Farida Nassar <f.nassar@solsticegallery.com>
Date:10 May
Subject:Client meeting plan

Dear Callum,

I have settled the agenda for the meeting with Mr. Ninh from Ashgate House on 16 May. We will begin with the budget report and then move on to the design proposal. Please make sure the materials are well labeled and printed by Wednesday.

In addition, Mr. Ninh has requested that we bring the physical architectural models instead of only presenting digital slides. I am slightly concerned that the vehicle we reserved may not have adequate room for them. Could you check with Kestrel Fine Art Transit whether this will be a problem?

Best,

Farida

To:Callum Sweeney <c.sweeney@solsticegallery.com>
From:Kestrel Support <help@kestreltransit.co.uk>
Date:11 May
Subject:Re: Reservation 6317-C
Attachment:Revised_Invoice_6317C

Dear Mr. Sweeney,

As requested in your e-mail yesterday, we have adjusted your company’s reservation. Attached is the revised invoice showing the change. Please review it carefully to make sure that everything is right.

Please note also that the crew are scheduled to arrive at your office at 8:00 A.M. Please have all items ready for loading when they arrive so that no time is lost.

If you have further questions or requests, do not hesitate to get in touch.

Yours sincerely,

Customer Service Team
Kestrel Fine Art Transit

Ngày: ngày 5 tháng Năm
Khách hàng: Solstice Gallery
Số đặt chỗ: 6317-C
Ngày thực hiện dịch vụ: ngày 16 tháng Năm
Hạn thanh toán: ngày 12 tháng Năm (Mọi khoản thanh toán là chung cuộc)
Chi tiết dịch vụ và bảng phân tích chi phí
Mục | Mô tả | Chi phí

3 | Bảo hiểm vận chuyển (toàn phần) | 60,00 bảng
4 | Phí bốc dỡ của nhân viên (5 giờ) | 125,00 bảng
| Tổng chi phí | 410,00 bảng
Chính sách điều chỉnh
Để tránh bị phạt, mọi đề nghị thay đổi lượt đặt chỗ phải được đưa ra ít nhất mười ngày (10 ngày) trước ngày thực hiện dịch vụ đã định. Những điều chỉnh được yêu cầu sau mốc đó sẽ dẫn tới một khoản phí hành chính 35 bảng trên hóa đơn cuối cùng.

Gửi: Callum Sweeney <c.sweeney@solsticegallery.com>
Từ: Farida Nassar <f.nassar@solsticegallery.com>
Ngày: ngày 10 tháng Năm
Chủ đề: Kế hoạch họp với khách hàng

Callum thân mến,
Tôi đã chốt xong chương trình cho cuộc họp với ông Ninh từ Ashgate House vào ngày 16 tháng Năm. Chúng ta sẽ bắt đầu với báo cáo ngân sách rồi chuyển sang bản đề xuất thiết kế. Xin anh bảo đảm tài liệu được dán nhãn cẩn thận và in xong trước thứ Tư.
Ngoài ra, ông Ninh đã đề nghị chúng ta mang theo các mô hình kiến trúc thực thay vì chỉ trình chiếu bản kỹ thuật số. Tôi hơi lo rằng chiếc xe chúng ta đã đặt có thể không đủ chỗ cho chúng. Anh kiểm tra với Kestrel Fine Art Transit xem việc này có thành vấn đề không nhé?
Thân mến,
Farida

Gửi: Callum Sweeney <c.sweeney@solsticegallery.com>
Từ: Kestrel Support <help@kestreltransit.co.uk>
Ngày: ngày 11 tháng Năm
Chủ đề: Trả lời: Lượt đặt chỗ 6317-C
Tệp đính kèm: Revised_Invoice_6317C

Kính gửi ông Sweeney,
Theo đề nghị trong thư điện tử của ông hôm qua, chúng tôi đã điều chỉnh lượt đặt chỗ của công ty ông. Đính kèm là hóa đơn đã sửa thể hiện thay đổi đó. Xin ông xem kỹ để bảo đảm mọi thứ đều chính xác.
Cũng xin lưu ý rằng nhân viên của chúng tôi dự kiến tới văn phòng của ông lúc 8:00 sáng. Xin ông chuẩn bị sẵn toàn bộ hiện vật để bốc lên xe khi họ tới, sao cho không mất thời gian.
Nếu ông có thêm câu hỏi hay đề nghị nào, xin đừng ngần ngại liên hệ.
Trân trọng,
Đội Chăm sóc Khách hàng
Kestrel Fine Art Transit

Date: 5 May

Reservation #: 6317-C
Service Date: 16 May
Payment Due Date: 12 May (All Payments Final)

Service Details & Cost Breakdown

ItemDescriptionCost
1Standard Panel Van (2 crew)£180.00

4Crew Handling Fee (5 hours)£125.00
 Total Cost£410.00

Modification Policy

To avoid a penalty, any request to change the booking must be made at least ten days (10 days) before the scheduled service date. Modifications requested after that date will lead to a £35 administration charge on the final bill.

To:Callum Sweeney <c.sweeney@solsticegallery.com>
From:Farida Nassar <f.nassar@solsticegallery.com>
Date:10 May
Subject:Client meeting plan

Dear Callum,

I have settled the agenda for the meeting with Mr. Ninh from Ashgate House on 16 May. We will begin with the budget report and then move on to the design proposal. Please make sure the materials are well labeled and printed by Wednesday.

In addition, Mr. Ninh has requested that we bring the physical architectural models instead of only presenting digital slides. I am slightly concerned that the vehicle we reserved may not have adequate room for them. Could you check with Kestrel Fine Art Transit whether this will be a problem?

Best,

Farida

To:Callum Sweeney <c.sweeney@solsticegallery.com>
From:Kestrel Support <help@kestreltransit.co.uk>
Date:11 May
Subject:Re: Reservation 6317-C
Attachment:Revised_Invoice_6317C

Dear Mr. Sweeney,

As requested in your e-mail yesterday, we have adjusted your company’s reservation. Attached is the revised invoice showing the change. Please review it carefully to make sure that everything is right.

Please note also that the crew are scheduled to arrive at your office at 8:00 A.M. Please have all items ready for loading when they arrive so that no time is lost.

If you have further questions or requests, do not hesitate to get in touch.

Yours sincerely,

Customer Service Team
Kestrel Fine Art Transit

questions.passage:
Ashvale Airport to Add Quiet Rest Lounges

By Nadia Krause, Transit Monthly

Ashvale International Airport has unveiled a plan to significantly improve the experience of transit passengers. Recognizing that waits of two hours or more are common among passengers with connecting flights, who account for roughly 35 percent of daily traffic, the airport management has decided to add more food counters and to install sound-insulated rest booths in Terminal 3.

The refurbishment project consists of two main stages. Stage 1 involves the rebuilding of the Market Hall to offer better food choices and is scheduled to be finished by 14 October. Once the food area is fully functional, Stage 2 will begin, converting the waiting area beside Gate 40 into the new Quiet Zone. Management expects the whole project to be complete before the winter travel season.

NOTICE: Refurbishment Update

Posted on 14 October

We would like to update passengers and staff on the progress of the ongoing facility renovation at Ashvale International Airport. Please be advised that the Market Hall is scheduled to reopen in three weeks.

In addition, work on the Quiet Zone will start next week. Please note that the general waiting area beside Gate 40 will be closed off. The Ashvale Club Lounge, on the upper floor of Terminal 3, will however stay open and accessible to all eligible passengers while the work goes on.

http://www.ashvaleairport.com/passenger-reviews

Ashvale Airport – Passenger Reviews

A good layover despite the building work
By: Miguel Sandoval
Date: 20 October

I had a four-hour layover on my way to a trade fair, and I was relieved to find that the lounge on the upper floor of Terminal 3 was still running. I was able to access by showing my Air Travel Rewards card, and it gave me a quiet place to work and enjoy a light meal.

Also, as I arrived at Terminal 1, I used the shuttle bus to get across to Terminal 3 for my connecting flight. Since my flight got in very late, I was glad the shuttle runs at every hour of the day and night.
questions.passageTranslationVi:
Sân bay Ashvale sẽ bổ sung các khoang nghỉ yên tĩnh
Bài của Nadia Krause, Transit Monthly
Sân bay Quốc tế Ashvale đã công bố một kế hoạch nhằm cải thiện đáng kể trải nghiệm của hành khách quá cảnh. Nhận thấy rằng những khoảng chờ từ hai tiếng trở lên là chuyện thường gặp ở hành khách có chuyến bay nối chuyến, nhóm chiếm khoảng 35 phần trăm lưu lượng hằng ngày, ban quản lý sân bay đã quyết định bổ sung thêm các quầy đồ ăn và lắp đặt những khoang nghỉ cách âm tại Nhà ga số 3.
Dự án cải tạo gồm hai giai đoạn chính. Giai đoạn 1 bao gồm việc xây dựng lại Khu Chợ nhằm mang tới lựa chọn đồ ăn tốt hơn và theo kế hoạch sẽ hoàn thành trước ngày 14 tháng Mười. Sau khi khu ẩm thực đi vào hoạt động đầy đủ, Giai đoạn 2 sẽ bắt đầu, chuyển khu vực chờ cạnh Cửa 40 thành Khu Yên tĩnh mới. Ban quản lý dự kiến toàn bộ dự án sẽ hoàn tất trước mùa du lịch đông.

questions.passage:
Ashvale Airport to Add Quiet Rest Lounges

By Nadia Krause, Transit Monthly

Ashvale International Airport has unveiled a plan to significantly improve the experience of transit passengers. Recognizing that waits of two hours or more are common among passengers with connecting flights, who account for roughly 35 percent of daily traffic, the airport management has decided to add more food counters and to install sound-insulated rest booths in Terminal 3.

The refurbishment project consists of two main stages. Stage 1 involves the rebuilding of the Market Hall to offer better food choices and is scheduled to be finished by 14 October. Once the food area is fully functional, Stage 2 will begin, converting the waiting area beside Gate 40 into the new Quiet Zone. Management expects the whole project to be complete before the winter travel season.

NOTICE: Refurbishment Update

Posted on 14 October

We would like to update passengers and staff on the progress of the ongoing facility renovation at Ashvale International Airport. Please be advised that the Market Hall is scheduled to reopen in three weeks.

In addition, work on the Quiet Zone will start next week. Please note that the general waiting area beside Gate 40 will be closed off. The Ashvale Club Lounge, on the upper floor of Terminal 3, will however stay open and accessible to all eligible passengers while the work goes on.

A good layover despite the building work
By: Miguel Sandoval
Date: 20 October

I had a four-hour layover on my way to a trade fair, and I was relieved to find that the lounge on the upper floor of Terminal 3 was still running. I was able to access by showing my Air Travel Rewards card, and it gave me a quiet place to work and enjoy a light meal.

Also, as I arrived at Terminal 1, I used the shuttle bus to get across to Terminal 3 for my connecting flight. Since my flight got in very late, I was glad the shuttle runs at every hour of the day and night.

questions.passage:
Ashvale Airport to Add Quiet Rest Lounges

By Nadia Krause, Transit Monthly

Ashvale International Airport has unveiled a plan to significantly improve the experience of transit passengers. Recognizing that waits of two hours or more are common among passengers with connecting flights, who account for roughly 35 percent of daily traffic, the airport management has decided to add more food counters and to install sound-insulated rest booths in Terminal 3.

The refurbishment project consists of two main stages. Stage 1 involves the rebuilding of the Market Hall to offer better food choices and is scheduled to be finished by 14 October. Once the food area is fully functional, Stage 2 will begin, converting the waiting area beside Gate 40 into the new Quiet Zone. Management expects the whole project to be complete before the winter travel season.

NOTICE: Refurbishment Update

Posted on 14 October

We would like to update passengers and staff on the progress of the ongoing facility renovation at Ashvale International Airport. Please be advised that the Market Hall is scheduled to reopen in three weeks.

In addition, work on the Quiet Zone will start next week. Please note that the general waiting area beside Gate 40 will be closed off. The Ashvale Club Lounge, on the upper floor of Terminal 3, will however stay open and accessible to all eligible passengers while the work goes on.

http://www.ashvaleairport.com/passenger-reviews

Ashvale Airport – Passenger Reviews

A good layover despite the building work
By: Miguel Sandoval
Date: 20 October

I had a four-hour layover on my way to a trade fair, and I was relieved to find that the lounge on the upper floor of Terminal 3 was still running. I was able to access by showing my Air Travel Rewards card, and it gave me a quiet place to work and enjoy a light meal.

Also, as I arrived at Terminal 1, I used the shuttle bus to get across to Terminal 3 for my connecting flight. Since my flight got in very late, I was glad the shuttle runs at every hour of the day and night.
